measured.host: Vultr CPU-Optimized 16 vCPU EPYC Genoa, Dallas
measured.finding: Spread across best and worst lighting under 20%. Caps never engaged. One CRF setting covers the full range; no per-show tuning required. Predicted 4-6 Mbps on noisy source; measured 3.16-3.43. Prediction FAILED — master's own 10 Mbps VBR pass plus the downscale remove most grain before x264 sees it.

rules.never_upscale: Skip any rung at or above source height. Report SKIPPED (blue), not FAILED (red).
rules.master_is_top_rung: The master is linked in place, never re-encoded, whatever its resolution.
rules.aspect: Scale by height with -2 width. Preserve source aspect. No padding.
rules.rejected: 2-pass VBR — 61% slower than CRF and produced a LARGER file at equal quality. Measured, not assumed.
